incidents.title: SF: 399 overdose deaths through September; xylazine in 10, medetomidine in 3
incidents.molecules: xylazine, bromazolam, fluorofentanyl, medetomidine, phenazolam, ethyl bromazolam, N-propionitrile chlorphine (cychlorphine), desalkylgidazepam
incidents.summary: Preliminary count for January to September 2026. Among the newer drugs the Medical Examiner tracks, xylazine was in 10 deaths, bromazolam 5, fluorofentanyl 4, medetomidine 3 (1 a month earlier), phenazolam 2, cychlorphine 1.
incidents.source: SF Office of the Chief Medical Examiner

incidents.title: SF overdose deaths down 24% so far this year
incidents.summary: 351 preliminary accidental overdose deaths January to August 2026, against 460 in the same months of 2025. Fentanyl was involved in 249 of the 351.
incidents.source: SF Office of the Chief Medical Examiner

incidents.title: US: carfentanil, fluorofentanyl and methylfentanyl in 12,500 deaths since 2023
incidents.summary: White House drug threat notice. CDC estimates since 2023: fluorofentanyl in nearly 12,000 deaths, carfentanil nearly 600, methylfentanyl about 50. Carfentanil samples rose 206% since 2024; standard fentanyl urine screens miss it.

incidents.title: Chicago: cychlorphine in 6 deaths, January to June 2026
incidents.summary: NDEWS sentinel-site report: cychlorphine was identified in 6 decedents by toxicology in the first half of 2026, found with benzodiazepines (bromazolam, etizolam, alprazolam, flubromazepam) and other drugs.
incidents.source: NIDA NDEWS Sentinel Site Report, July 2026

incidents.title: Clark County: 714 overdose deaths in 2025, down 11%
incidents.summary: Southern Nevada Health District's 2025 count. Opioids were in 69.6% of the deaths. The fentanyl-involved death rate rose from 2.4 per 100,000 in 2018 to 17.1 in 2025; deaths peaked in June to August.

incidents.title: US overdose deaths fell again in 2025
incidents.summary: CDC provisional data: an estimated 69,973 overdose deaths in 2025, down almost 14% from 81,313 in 2024, the third straight yearly decline. Opioid-involved deaths fell from 55,296 to 44,564.

incidents.title: Philadelphia: medetomidine in 92 overdose deaths in 2024
incidents.summary: The Medical Examiner began testing for medetomidine in May 2024 and found it in 9% of the year's 1,069 overdose deaths, every one with fentanyl. Xylazine was in 364 (34%).

incidents.title: At least 55 US deaths linked to cychlorphine
incidents.summary: White House drug policy office: most common in Ohio, Texas and Tennessee across 2025 and 2026.
incidents.source: White House ONDCP drug threat notice

incidents.title: SF's first cychlorphine death, after suspected counterfeit pills
incidents.summary: A 16-year-old died at home on April 7. Health officials said he likely took counterfeit pills; toxicology found cychlorphine, N-desethyl isotonitazene and ethyl bromazolam, and no fentanyl.

incidents.title: East Tennessee: 41 deaths tied to cychlorphine
incidents.summary: Cychlorphine was found in the toxicology of 41 deaths across 11 East Tennessee counties, July 2025 to February 2026, with five more under review.

incidents.title: California: 5 deaths with medetomidine in 2025
incidents.summary: CDPH brief: all five deaths also involved fentanyl. Small amounts found in SF, San Diego, the Inland Empire and LA. Likely an undercount, since testing is limited.

incidents.title: LA County confirms its first cychlorphine death
incidents.summary: The medical examiner confirmed a February 2026 death as the county's first involving cychlorphine, its first sign in the local supply. Naloxone works, but more than one dose may be needed.

incidents.title: SF counted 621 overdose deaths in 2025, some with newer drugs
incidents.molecules: fluorofentanyl, xylazine, bromazolam, phenazolam, medetomidine, desalkylgidazepam, ethyl bromazolam
incidents.summary: The medical examiner's preliminary 2025 count: 621 accidental overdose deaths. Newer drugs appeared in some: fluorofentanyl in 38, xylazine 27, bromazolam 12, phenazolam 6, medetomidine 4.
incidents.source: SF Office of the Chief Medical Examiner

incidents.title: San Diego: 2 deaths involving nitazenes
incidents.summary: NDEWS's July 2026 report lists two San Diego deaths with N-pyrrolidino protonitazene, May 2025 and February 2026; the nitazene has not shown up in local drug-checking samples.

incidents.title: SF: 4 deaths involving nitazenes since 2024
incidents.summary: Three in 2024 and one in 2025; nitazenes are rarely detected in the local supply.

incidents.title: Riverside County confirms first fatal carfentanil overdose
incidents.summary: A man in his 40s who died in March 2025; confirmation took months because the death happened outside the county.

incidents.title: Santa Clara County's first carfentanil death
incidents.summary: A 39-year-old man died of a carfentanil overdose and was found with counterfeit M30 pills. Carfentanil is about 100 times stronger than fentanyl.
